behavior: 21 new singles attacks; numeric IDs of all 612 existing moves preserved; Stored Power positive-stage scaling corrected.
Natural level tables cover 809 server species; full per-species review for the 493 playable Pokédex species.
43 level records restored/added; full Sandshrew table, Vise Grip aliases, new natural moves.
New wild encounters use at most four distinct natural moves already available at their level; no TM/future-level selection or invented duplicate slots.
Explicit Adventure starter sets and author-defined trainer teams remain unchanged; historical Colosseum v1–v4 generators keep their original catalog.
CS: 101 to 263, documented TM/tutor compatibility through generation 7; new additions also accept their actual USUM natural/egg compatibility as a RiftMon extension.
Store remains after Hoze, prices 3000/4000/5000; unrelated items, 101 old prices/compatibilities and saved move sets retained.
CS type filter/color label and Aurora Veil public timer/screen added; current animations reused for all three modes.
limits: Spotlight is excluded because its mechanic requires doubles, absent in RiftMon. Four natural level entries concern it; explicitly reported per species.
Generation 5–7 species remain server-compatible but are outside the exhaustive playable 493-species review; this does not claim every later exclusive move is implemented.
No rewriting of already-owned Pokémon or retroactive pending moves; new natural offers occur at next eligible levels and new CS provide the extra teaching paths.

Global suite is not green: all 21 failures also reproduce on the baseline; four old inventory-audit failures were fixed by recognizing existing Gwenn/Professor keys in test fixtures. No unrelated story/map behavior changed.
No physical mobile device or exhaustive proof of every move combination; browser and real SQL on disposable accounts were used.
